split_rule: seed 0:20 train, 20:40 calibration, 40:50 validation, per class

semantic_definition.REMOVE_OCCLUDER: manipulate a physical occluder or container
semantic_definition.ROTATE: grasp, wrist-rotate for a new object view, then place down
semantic_definition.MOVE_CLOSER: grasp and move the end effector toward the camera for inspection
